# Overview {-}

**Question.** Does bulk Coomassie-stained soluble and insoluble protein content, or the insoluble-to-soluble ratio, differ between Adult and Old sedentary mice, and does the age effect depend on sex?

| Item | As implemented below |
|---|---|
| Input | `Aggregates_Sol and Insoluble Coomassie_Mesquita.xlsx` (repeated header rows are removed) |
| Groups | Adult sed and Old sed; Female and Male |
| Values | Raw values (`use_normalized <- FALSE`); outcomes Soluble, Insoluble and Insol/Sol ratio |
| Model (each outcome) | `lm(Value ~ Age * Sex)` with sum-to-zero contrasts; Type III ANOVA (`car::Anova`, F tests) for Age, Sex and Age × Sex |
| Planned contrasts | Old - Adult within each sex (`emmeans`, `revpairwise`), **unadjusted** (`adjust = "none"`); saved to `Bulk_AO_age_within_sex.csv` |
| Figures | Bars = mean ± SEM by sex and age; points = individual animals; subtitle *P* values are the Type III terms |

The unit of replication is the animal. Figures are saved to `Bulk_AO/` (PNG, 300 dpi) and are also shown in this report right after the chunk that creates them.

> **To run:** keep the input workbook next to this file and knit. This script also contains the `PAPER BRIDGE` / `PAPER FINISH` blocks of your paper workflow; they stop the script unless a `Paper/shared/attach.R` folder is found above the working directory (see CHANGES).

# Helper functions

```{r helpers}
darken_col <- function(col, factor = 0.70) {

  rgb_mat <- grDevices::col2rgb(col) / 255

  grDevices::rgb(red = rgb_mat[1, ] * factor, green = rgb_mat[2, ] * factor, blue = rgb_mat[3, ] * factor)
}

save_png <- function(plot_obj, filename, width, height, dpi = 300) {

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = filename,
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

round_up_to <- function(x, base) {
  base *
    ceiling(x / base)
}

mean_sem <- function(x) {

  n <- sum(!is.na(x))

  m <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)

  s <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)

  se <- s /
    sqrt(n)

  tibble(n = n, mean = m, sd = s, sem = se)
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {

  ifelse(is.na(p), "NA", ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
}

console_print <- function(x) {

  cat(paste(capture.output(print(x)), collapse = "\n"), "\n")

  invisible(x)
}

theme_bulk <- function(base_size = 18) {

  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 4),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_size, colour = "#4D4D4D"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1),
      axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black", size = base_size - 1),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1.1),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1.1),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.18, "cm"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
    )
}
```

# Import and clean data

```{r import}
raw_df <- readxl::read_excel(in_file)

# Remove repeated header rows that were embedded in the spreadsheet
raw_df <- raw_df %>%
  filter(Group != "Group") %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(RawSoluble, RawInsoluble, `RawInsol/Sol`, NormSoluble, NormInsoluble, `NormInsol/Sol`), as.numeric),
    Sex = str_to_title(as.character(Sex)),
    Group = str_squish(as.character(Group))
  )

# Restrict to Adult vs Old sedentary comparison only
bulk_df <- raw_df %>%
  filter(Group %in% c("Adult sed", "Old sed"), Sex %in% c("Female", "Male")) %>%
  mutate(
    Age = case_when(Group == "Adult sed" ~ "Adult", Group == "Old sed" ~ "Old", TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    Age = factor(Age, levels = c("Adult", "Old")),
    Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )

console_print(bulk_df)
```

# Build analysis table

```{r long-data}
measure_map <- if (use_normalized) {
  c(Soluble = "NormSoluble", Insoluble = "NormInsoluble", Ratio = "NormInsol/Sol")
} else {
  c(Soluble = "RawSoluble", Insoluble = "RawInsoluble", Ratio = "RawInsol/Sol")
}

bulk_long <- bind_rows(
  bulk_df %>%
    transmute(ID, Age, Sex, Outcome = "Soluble", Value = .data[[measure_map[["Soluble"]]]]),
  bulk_df %>%
    transmute(ID, Age, Sex, Outcome = "Insoluble", Value = .data[[measure_map[["Insoluble"]]]]),
  bulk_df %>%
    transmute(ID, Age, Sex, Outcome = "Insol/Sol", Value = .data[[measure_map[["Ratio"]]]])
) %>%
  mutate(Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = c("Soluble", "Insoluble", "Insol/Sol")))

summary_tbl <- bulk_long %>%
  group_by(Outcome, Sex, Age) %>%
  summarise(mean_sem(Value), .groups = "drop")

readr::write_csv(summary_tbl, file.path(out_dir, "Bulk_AO_summary.csv"))

console_print(summary_tbl)
```

# Statistics

```{r stats}
analyze_outcome <- function(df, outcome_name) {

  sub_df <- df %>%
    filter(Outcome == outcome_name) %>%
    droplevels()

  # Type III 2 x 2 factorial ANOVA, matching the other manuscript workflows.
  contrasts(sub_df$Age) <- contr.sum(nlevels(sub_df$Age))

  contrasts(sub_df$Sex) <- contr.sum(nlevels(sub_df$Sex))

  fit <- lm(Value ~ Age * Sex, data = sub_df)

  a3 <- car::Anova(fit, type = 3)

  p_col <- grep("^Pr\\(", colnames(a3), value = TRUE)[1]

  anova_tbl <- tibble(Outcome = outcome_name, Term = rownames(a3), p_value = as.numeric(a3[, p_col])) %>%
    filter(Term %in% c("Age", "Sex", "Age:Sex"))

  em_age_within_sex <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ Age | Sex)

  age_contrasts <- emmeans::contrast(em_age_within_sex, method = "revpairwise", adjust = "none") %>%
    broom::tidy() %>%
    mutate(Outcome = outcome_name)

  list(fit = fit, anova = anova_tbl, contrasts = age_contrasts)
}

stat_list <- setNames(
  lapply(
    levels(bulk_long$Outcome),
    function(x) {
      analyze_outcome(bulk_long, x)
    }
  ),
  levels(bulk_long$Outcome)
)

anova_all <- bind_rows(lapply(stat_list, `[[`, "anova"))

contrast_all <- bind_rows(lapply(stat_list, `[[`, "contrasts"))

stats_wide <- anova_all %>%
  select(Outcome, Term, p_value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Term, values_from = p_value) %>%
  mutate(stats_label = paste0("Age=", fmt_p(Age), " | Sex=", fmt_p(Sex), " | Int=", fmt_p(`Age:Sex`)))

get_stats_label <- function(outcome_name) {

  stats_wide %>%
    filter(Outcome == outcome_name) %>%
    pull(stats_label)
}

combined_stats_label <- paste0(
  "<b>Sol:</b> ",
  get_stats_label("Soluble"),
  "<br>",
  "<b>Insol:</b> ",
  get_stats_label("Insoluble"),
  "<br>",
  "<b>Insol/Sol:</b> ",
  get_stats_label("Insol/Sol")
)

readr::write_csv(anova_all, file.path(out_dir, "Bulk_AO_anova_type3.csv"))

readr::write_csv(contrast_all, file.path(out_dir, "Bulk_AO_age_within_sex.csv"))

readr::write_csv(stats_wide, file.path(out_dir, "Bulk_AO_pvalues.csv"))

console_print(anova_all)
console_print(contrast_all)
console_print(stats_wide)
```

# Plot helpers

```{r plot-helpers}
make_sep_plot <- function(
  outcome_name,
  ylab_text,
  title_text,
  file_stub,
  y_labels = label_number(big.mark = ","),
  expand_mult = c(0, 0.08)
) {

  sub_points <- bulk_long %>%
    filter(Outcome == outcome_name)

  sub_sum <- summary_tbl %>%
    filter(Outcome == outcome_name)

  p <- ggplot(sub_sum, aes(x = Sex, y = mean)) +
    geom_col(
      aes(fill = Age, colour = Age),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
      width = 0.62,
      linewidth = 1.25,
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem, colour = Age),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
      width = 0.13,
      linewidth = 1.0
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = sub_points,
      aes(x = Sex, y = Value, fill = Age, colour = Age, shape = Sex),
      position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.07, dodge.width = 0.72, seed = 1),
      size = 3.2,
      stroke = 0.95,
      alpha = 0.98
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = age_fill_cols, name = NULL) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = age_border_cols, name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = sex_shapes, name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = y_labels, expand = expansion(mult = expand_mult)) +
    labs(title = title_text, subtitle = get_stats_label(outcome_name), x = NULL, y = ylab_text) +
    theme_bulk() +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black", margin = margin(b = 5)),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  save_png(p, file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stub, ".png")), width = sep_w, height = sep_h)

  p
}
```

# Figure 4 — Combined figure

```{r fig-combined, fig.keep='none'}
content_max <- bulk_long %>%
  filter(Outcome %in% c("Soluble", "Insoluble")) %>%
  summarise(max_val = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(max_val)

left_axis_max <- round_up_to(content_max * 1.20, 1e6)

right_axis_max <- 2.0

ratio_scale <- left_axis_max /
  right_axis_max

metric_centers <- c("Soluble" = 1, "Insoluble" = 2, "Insol/Sol" = 4)

age_offsets <- c("Adult" = -0.14, "Old" = 0.14)

comb_sum <- summary_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    x = metric_centers[as.character(Outcome)] +
      age_offsets[as.character(Age)],
    plot_mean = if_else(Outcome == "Insol/Sol", mean * ratio_scale, mean),
    plot_sem = if_else(Outcome == "Insol/Sol", sem * ratio_scale, sem)
  )

comb_pts <- bulk_long %>%
  mutate(
    x = metric_centers[as.character(Outcome)] +
      age_offsets[as.character(Age)],
    plot_value = if_else(Outcome == "Insol/Sol", Value * ratio_scale, Value)
  )

make_combined_plot <- function(show_stats = FALSE) {

  ggplot() +
    geom_col(
      data = comb_sum,
      aes(x = x, y = plot_mean, fill = Age, colour = Age),
      width = 0.24,
      linewidth = 1.25,
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      data = comb_sum,
      aes(x = x, ymin = plot_mean - plot_sem, ymax = plot_mean + plot_sem, colour = Age),
      width = 0.08,
      linewidth = 1.0
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = comb_pts,
      aes(x = x, y = plot_value, fill = Age, colour = Age, shape = Sex),
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.035, height = 0, seed = 1),
      size = 3.05,
      stroke = 0.95,
      alpha = 0.98
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 3, linewidth = 1.1, linetype = "longdash", colour = "grey35") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = age_fill_cols, name = NULL) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = age_border_cols, name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = sex_shapes, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(1, 2, 4),
      labels = c("Soluble", "Insoluble", "Insol/sol"),
      limits = c(0.5, 4.6),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Protein content (A.U.)",
      limits = c(0, left_axis_max),
      breaks = seq(0, left_axis_max, by = left_axis_max / 3),
      labels = label_scientific(digits = 2),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(
        local({ rs <- ratio_scale; ~ . / rs }),
        name = "Ratio",
        breaks = seq(0, right_axis_max, by = 0.5)
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Soluble and insoluble proteins",
      subtitle = if (show_stats) {
        combined_stats_label
      } else {
        NULL
      },
      x = NULL,
      y = "Protein content (A.U.)"
    ) +
    theme_bulk(base_size = 20) +
    theme(
      axis.title.y.right = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 270, vjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18),
      plot.subtitle = if (show_stats) {
        ggtext::element_markdown(size = 13.5, colour = "black", lineheight = 1.18, margin = margin(b = 8))
      } else {
        element_blank()
      },
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

# Version 1: clean combined figure
p_combined <- make_combined_plot(show_stats = FALSE)

save_png(p_combined, file.path(out_dir, "Bulk_AO_Combined.png"), width = comb_w, height = comb_h)

# Version 2: combined figure with factorial p-values
p_combined_pvals <- make_combined_plot(show_stats = TRUE)

save_png(p_combined_pvals, file.path(out_dir, "Bulk_AO_Combined_pvals.png"), width = comb_w, height = comb_h + 0.7)

cat("Saved: ", file.path(out_dir, "Bulk_AO_Combined.png"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Saved: ", file.path(out_dir, "Bulk_AO_Combined_pvals.png"), "\n", sep = "")
```
